description: FRIC-1781460000 — the GREEN twin of tc-FW-bad-owners-addition-orphans-signoff-entry. Same candidate (the OWNERS addition resolves oya-ci-required.yml out of the unowned set; the frozen merge-base reference still carries it), but the orphaned sign-off entry has been RETIRED (removed from _sign_off_additions, as the signoff-fixer --fix would do). With no orphaned entry, there is nothing inert: the firewall is GREEN at PR time. This proves the fix is the orthodox ratchet shape — an orphaning PR fails closed UNTIL it bundles the (mechanically derivable) retirement, then passes. The still-present frozen debt (still-unowned.rs) stays tolerated and is advisory, so no code fails.
